test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Four sentences are given, out of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all the correctly spelled words.**

options.text: The whole thing is foriegn to us.
It is demonstrably an unfair comparsion.
There is a room at the extreme end of the corridor.
I'm the sole victim of Mother's tyrany.

solution:
The correct answer is **"There is a room at the extreme end of the corridor."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The reason the sentence **"There is a room at the extreme end of the corridor" **is correct is that all the words are spelled accurately:

 
 
• **"There"** is correctly spelled.
 
• **"Room"** is correctly spelled.
 
• **"Extreme" **is correctly spelled.
 
• **"End"** is correctly spelled.
 
• **"Corridor"** is correctly spelled.
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The whole thing is foriegn to us.**

 
 
• The correct spelling of **"foriegn"** should be** "foreign."**
 
 
 
• **It is demonstrably an unfair comparsion.**
 
 
• The correct spelling of **"comparsion"** should be **"comparison."**​
 
 
 
• **​I'm the sole victim of Mother's tyrany.**
 
 
• **​**The correct spelling of **"tyrany"** should be **"tyranny."**
